text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho has arrived.
Tamamo Cross
is competing, so Oguri
Cap and I came to scope
her out.
However...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's pulled ahead! Tamamo Cross has
taken the
lead! Tamamo Cross is out in
front! Tamamo Cross
is leading the pack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross breaks away from the
middle and
immediately overtakes
everyone in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross blazes forward at
lightning speed!
She's got a commanding
lead!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: She's truly fast... and powerful too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I really want to compete against Tama!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's only one choice for
our next
race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm gonna give her a run for her
money!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is still ahead of us, but
Oguri
Cap has already found her next
goal!
